text:
maria: Heads up — prepping a stable RC off main for tomorrow's promo. Tag: rc/stable-2026-03-21. No DB schema changes; feature flags for risky paths will be toggled during canary. Can we lock deps and get a quick ops pin? cc @chris @nitya @sam-sheriff
chris: ACK. What's the bake window and canary size?
maria: Bake 30m, canary 2% -> bump to 20% after smoke. I'll run KV warm: `./scripts/warm-kv.sh --prefix rc/stable-2026-03-21`
dev-deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Candidate created: rc/stable-2026-03-21 by maria. Artifact: infra-service:sha256:abcd1234. To test in staging: `/deploy promote rc/stable-2026-03-21 --env staging`
nitya: I'll run interop + perf smoke on staging now. ETA ~18m.
sam-sheriff: Oncall ack. Abort criteria: errors > 5% or latency P95 increase > 100ms (absolute > 250ms) during canary -> immediate rollback to prod:release/2026-03-10. Ops must approve any pin.
chris: Ops approve pin for infra-service image sha256:abcd1234 :thumbsup:
maria: Pin recorded in release-manager. Draft release notes: - Fix session stall under burst - Improve KV warm path - No DB schema changes. Will paste changelog link when ready.
qa-lead: Staging interop all green. Perf smoke: token-gen P95 180ms, throughput looks stable. No functional regressions.
dev-deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Initiating canary promo to prod with 2% traffic. Command issued: `promote --rc rc/stable-2026-03-21 --to prod --canary 2`
maria: Starting monitors (errors, p95, SLO dashboards). Will watch logs and tracing.
sam-sheriff: Seeing a small 3xx spike in eu-west region, digging into traces... If spike persists > 10m we trim canary.
chris: I toggled ff.session-streaming -> off for the canary.
maria: Traffic steady, error rate at baseline. Bumping to 20% in ~12m per plan.
dev-deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary scaled to 20%. KV warm status: success. Metrics snapshot: errors 0.4% (baseline 0.5), p95 190ms.
nitya: Perf looks clean at 20%. Approving full promo. :rocket:
maria: Promoting to full prod now. Pin `rc/stable-2026-03-21` applied in release-manager.
dev-deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Promotion to prod complete. New prod tag: rc/stable-2026-03-21. Rollback command: `/deploy rollback prod --to release/2026-03-10`
sam-sheriff: Quiet so far. I'll keep an eye on error budget and routing.
chris: Release note published: https://redwood.example.com/releases/rc-stable-2026-03-21. Great job team.
maria: Thanks all — closing the promo window in 30m. If anything pops, ping #eng-oncall and add an incident.
